findings.summary: The check says that the reference says "a hold in force stays in the entry file as one rule". The reference says: "A hold that the owner keeps is one present-tense rule: in the entry file when it is general, on the owning guide when it is about one item." So a hold about one item gets a home outside the entry file. The brief (one-pass, brief.md:261) has no such exception: "it stays in the entry file as one present-tense line". The text made with the spec (joycraft-prototype c586d0d) said "one rule in the entry file"; commit 0e09b24 added the split, and ee3ab75 (field-26) put it back after round 1. No word of the owner for the split is in the brief or the spec. The test [AC:temporal-homes] asserts the sentence with the split (tests/cleanup/cleanup-text.test.mjs:119-120), so it is green on this text. To pass: the reference keeps each hold in force in the entry file, or the owner amends the check and the brief to permit a hold on one item on its guide. Round 1 failed this check because the sentence was absent; this finding is about the sentence that field-26 added.

Commit ee3ab75 removed "A person asks for this pass." from the reference and from the assertion at line 148. The test title still says "the pass runs on a person request", but no assertion now checks it. The skill still says it (SKILL.md:19: "A person asks for a cleanup"), so the check holds on the text; the test asserts less than the check.

The reference does not say "one agent by default" in one sentence. A reader gets it from "One agent does each part" and "A small set is one part". It does not say how small a small set is (the 20,000 words of the sentence before are the only number), and it does not say that the coordinator is that one agent on a host that has subagents. Above about 20,000 words the split follows the statement of the cost with no wait for a yes; the text made with the spec (c586d0d) said "on a yes".
findings.assumption: "One agent does each part" with "A small set is one part" means that one agent does the pass unless the set is above about 20,000 words. The text that the check was written with also had fan-out for a large set.
